comment: One row per improver stage; every stage runs on Claude through upstream's claude_cli channel on this box's own Claude login (owner 2026-11-03: improver stages run on Claude; the solver is always EviMed Science on DeepSeek Flash and is not configured here). load_channels refuses any other kind, a model that is not claude-*, and any provider. max_budget_usd bounds one session as the CLI itself prices it (API-equivalent).
